subject: xinfo-stream add minimum to seen-time, skip logreqres in fuzzer (#13056)
reason: The change edits only metadata and test harness files: it adds a 'minimum: 0' annotation to the seen-time field in src/commands/xinfo-stream.json (documentation/schema metadata, not used by the server at runtime to compute or format replies) and adds a 'logreqres:skip' tag to tests/integration/corrupt-dump-fuzzer.tcl (a CI test configuration change). No server code path, command behavior, reply, replication, or persistence logic changed, so no scenario can reach a behavioral difference between the builds.
